metadata.datasource: FUJIFILM data sheet AF3-0258E (NEOPAN 100 ACROS II, 135), p3: charts are 300 dpi raster images, traced at 600 dpi (spectrogram to 5400 K daylight; D-76 characteristic curves).

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET (raster) 401-662 nm: the spectrogram to 5400 K daylight with a 5400 K black body divided out (ASSUMED source spectrum); ASSUMED held below 401 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0680 dex/nm above 662 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET (raster) for log_exposure -2.10..1.56 (D-76 small tank, 20 C, 7.25 min: the sheet's own time, interpolated between the 7 and 10 min curves; contrast index 0.572); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.802 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: SHEET ISO 100 + LIT: 0 = log10(0.8/100)+1.0 = -1.097 log lux-s
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0139 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
